name: sj-svalbard-payroll-tax
description: Calculate and administer Svalbard salary withholding for 2026 for resident employees and qualifying temporary workers. Covers gross salary, holiday pay, directors fees, pensions and specified benefits; the shared annual twelve-basic-amount threshold; multiple employers; standard housing, car and subsistence valuations; and the new youth allowance administered through refunds. Separates employee insurance contributions from the zero employer contribution rate and links to membership rules. Includes reporting, next-working-day remittance, corrections, departure accruals, penalties and two reproducible payroll calculations. Use for Svalbard payroll, a-melding, noncash benefits, wage tax and youth refunds. Jan Mayen and specialist project regimes are excluded. This source-cited draft awaits licensed professional review.
